name: I Only Date Free!
source:
Welcome to the wonderful world of Free! This is a fan project where you, the player, enter Iwatobi High School and find true love! This game is an otome visual novel, which means that it is geared towards girls; however, guys are also free to play!

NOTE: [URL=http://idatefree.tumblr.com/post/140986758834/uhm-guys-i-gues-you-abandoned-the-project-no]As of March 2016, the project has been declared officially dead by its creators[/URL].

[From the [url=http://idatefree.tumblr.com/faq]I Only Date Free! Official Website FAQ[/url]]
